findings.title: Fallback locales are only loaded by the controller filter, not by translate itself
findings.body: `I18n.translate` still lazy-loads only `config.locale`. The new fallback chain is `[locale, site default, :en]`, and `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` is called only from `ApplicationController#set_locale`. Any code outside a web request does not go through that filter. This includes Sidekiq jobs, mailers using `I18n.with_locale`, rake tasks and the console. In those contexts a key missing from the current locale falls back to locales that were never loaded, unless some earlier request in the same process happened to load them. For example, when the site default is `fr`, English is never loaded in a job process. The result is a "translation missing: ..." string instead of the English fallback. The loading should happen inside `translate`/`load_locale` for every locale in the chain, not in one controller filter.

findings.title: LRU cache key ignores the fallback chain, so cached results go stale
findings.body: The cache key is `key + config.locale + backend.object_id`. The result now also depends on `SiteSetting.default_locale`, which `FallbackLocaleList` puts in the chain. If a key is missing in the current locale, the value served from the site default locale (or the 'translation missing' string) is cached under the current locale only. After an admin changes `default_locale`, or after a fallback locale is loaded later, the process keeps returning the old cached fallback until the cache is evicted or `reload!` runs. The key should include the fallback chain or the default locale, or the cache should be cleared when `default_locale` changes.

findings.title: Fallbacks now enabled in every environment with no tests
findings.body: The PR removes `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` from the production, profile and cloud66 configs. It installs a custom `FallbackLocaleList` unconditionally, so dev and test now have fallbacks too, where they previously did not. No spec covers the new behavior: chain ordering (user, site default, en), lazy loading of the fallback locales, or the 'translation missing' case. Specs that relied on missing-translation behavior in a non-English locale may also silently change. A spec for `FallbackLocaleList#[]`, `ensure_loaded!` and an end-to-end lookup of a key present only in `en` should be added.

findings.title: Fallback lookup reads SiteSetting and allocates an array on every translate call
findings.body: `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks#translate` calls `I18n.fallbacks[locale]` on every lookup, not only when a key is missing. Each call now evaluates `SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym` and builds a new array through `uniq` and `compact`. Calls with arguments bypass the LRU cache in `translate_accelerator`, so they pay this cost every time. It also ties every translation to SiteSetting being readable. If `default_locale` were nil or unavailable, `nil.to_sym` would raise from inside I18n. The chain could be memoized per `(locale, default_locale)` instead.
